paras: ARD (ADRO Racing Division) is ADRO's motorsport engineering program, built for drivers who demand more from their car on track. Every ARD component is developed through CFD simulation and track tested before anything reaches a customer. Scott, ADRO's Head of Aerodynamics, brings an F1 development background to every ARD project. The GR Supra ARD Aero Package is the one of the first full systems to come out of that program.

Canards are one of the most visually recognizable elements in motorsport aero. They are also one of the most misused. On most aftermarket kits, they are aesthetic additions that generate marginal front downforce and little else. The ARD quad canards are developed to do something more specific: manage the vortices initiated by the front splitter assembly and direct airflow around the front wheels.
ft: ADRO ARD Prepreg Canards for Toyota GR Supra (ADRO Bumper) 2020+
